description: ATLAS Gold Standard Benchmark for Dense, Sparse, and Hybrid Retrieval

corpus.text: Deep learning models deployed for diagnostic imaging in diabetic retinopathy demonstrated an area under the ROC curve (AUC) of 0.984 across a multi-hospital cohort of 12,000 patients.
Algorithmic bias was observed where diagnostic sensitivity declined by 14% on underrepresented demographic sub-populations with lower illumination retinal photography.

The standardized approach for credit risk (SA-CR) under Basel IV introduces granular risk weights ranging between 20% and 150% depending on counterparty credit ratings and real estate loan-to-value ratios.
The output floor restricts internal ratings-based (IRB) model capital benefits to a maximum of 72.5% of the total risk-weighted assets calculated using standardized metrics.

The Raft consensus algorithm decomposes state machine replication into leader election, log replication, and safety invariants, guaranteeing that if any server applied an entry, no other server applies a different entry for that index.
Linearizable read-only queries in Raft require the leader to verify its leadership with a majority quorum heartbeat before responding to prevent stale reads from partitioned leaders.
Silicon-anode lithium-ion batteries achieve gravimetric energy densities reaching 400 Wh/kg, but suffer from 300% volumetric expansion during lithiation, resulting in mechanical degradation.
Solid-state electrolyte interfaces using sulfide ceramic separators reduce dendrite penetration at current densities up to 10 mA/cm2 when operated under 5 MPa stack pressure.
